Overview

Koper is a city in Koper with a population of 25,753. Slovenia’s only commercial port, a charming Venetian-influenced town on the Adriatic coast with a beautiful Tito Square, a historic palace, and a Mediterranean atmosphere. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
